title: A cultural stroll through Paris with singer Axel Bauer and painter Li Chevalier
summary: On this week’s Paris des Arts: two new albums take centre stage. Axel Bauer returns with “Grand Huit” more than 40 years after his legendary “Cargo”. And Gauvain Sers opens up in "Boulevard de l’Enfance”. Then, we shine a spotlight on painter Li Chevalier whose work is as poetic as it is philosophical.
